placements.title: Architectural contracts and system design decisions
placements.frame: What architectural contracts and design decisions structure the system's behavior?
placements.why: The async job contract is an architectural decision about how the system structures dispatch, retrieval, and loss-prevention. No existing strata category holds this; Architecture is the organizational home for system design contracts.

placements.title: Dispatch returns a receipt, not a result — retrieval becomes the caller's concern
placements.frame: What operational mechanics does the async job contract establish for dispatch, retrieval, and loss-prevention?
placements.why: Both segments perform the same ratified async job contract as a load-bearing operational rule: remember returns a receipt in seconds, extraction is watched by polling a cursor, no blocking call, no lost work. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — the contract's mechanics — not a one-time fact. No existing leaf holds this theme.
